preconditions.description: The number of intersections n and one-way roads m satisfy 2 <= n <= m <= 2 * 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road is defined by a pair of distinct intersections (u, v) where 1 <= u, v <= n.
The number of roads is exactly m.
The number of intersections in Polycarp's path k satisfies 2 <= k <= n.
The length of Polycarp's path is exactly k.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in path)
preconditions.description: Each intersection in Polycarp's path is a valid intersection number between 1 and n.
All intersections in Polycarp's path are pairwise distinct.

preconditions.expression: all((path[i], path[i + 1]) in roads for i in range(k - 1))
preconditions.description: Each consecutive pair of intersections in Polycarp's path is connected by a road.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of rebuilds is less than or equal to the maximum number of rebuilds.

postconditions.expression: min_rebuilds == sum(path[i] != shortest_path[i] for i in range(1, k - 1))
postconditions.description: The minimum number of rebuilds is the number of times Polycarp deviates from the shortest path.

postconditions.expression: max_rebuilds == k - 2 - sum(path[i] == shortest_path[i] for i in range(1, k - 1))
postconditions.description: The maximum number of rebuilds is the number of times Polycarp can deviate from the shortest path.
